title: I liked it but . . .
text: I liked it but . . .. Its a nice mirror. Looks nice and the cinnamon red paint in my bathroom subtly shows in parts of the palm leaves giving it an impressive effect. Unfortunately, after five years the silver coating of the mirror started chipping along the bottom, ruining the decorative mirror. I've suffered looking at the chipped bottom for another five years and am only going to replace it with the same mirror now because I am selling the home and it does provide a great accent to the bathroom. I doubt others will be happy with it over time.

product_metadata.title: Head West 4001 Wall Mirror, Gray
features: The translucent leaves allow the color of the wall to shine through, making it the perfect compliment to any color scheme
description: Add a striking focal point to any room with the Head West Palm Leaf Oval Mirror. This decorative frameless oval mirror features an authentic acid etched palm leaf pattern on the top and bottom, with simulated deep engraving.
